name: Moderation
intro: Actions for keeping your server in order. Every action creates a case and DMs the member.

commands.desc: Kicks a user from the server
Bans a user, even if they are not in the server. Duration is optional (Example: 7d)
Unbans a user from the server
Times out a user for X minutes. If they are not in the server, it applies when they join
Removes a timeout, or cancels a saved mute
Warns a user and logs the case
Removes a warning from a user
Deletes messages from a specific user
Sets slowmode in the current channel
Locks the current channel
Unlocks the current channel
Shows all locked channels

name: Cases
intro: Look up the moderation history of a member, or review your own.

commands.desc: Shows all cases for a user
Shows detailed info for a specific case
Sends your own moderation history for this server to your DMs
Deletes a case and voids the infraction

name: Autoroles
intro: Roles on join, roles that persist, and roles that expire on their own.

commands.desc: Shows current join roles
Sets join roles for new members
Removes all join roles
Adds roles to a user
Removes roles from a user
Removes all roles from a user
Toggles roles on a user
Clears all roles and sets one role
Persists roles through leave/rejoin
Removes a role persist
Clears persists and sets one
Toggles role persists
Gives a role that removes itself after the duration (e.g. 1m, 2h, 3d, 1w, 2mon, 1y)
Takes a timed role away early
Shows the active timed roles for a user

name: Tickets
intro: A private ticket system your members open with one click.

commands.desc: Sets up the ticket system
Posts the ticket creation panel with a button
Adds a user to the current ticket
Removes a user from the current ticket
Closes the current ticket

name: AutoMod
intro: Automatic protection against spam, scam links and raids.

commands.desc: Configure an automod type (0 to disable). Types: spam, scam, raids
Set the channel where automod actions are logged
Adds a user or role to the automod whitelist
Removes a user or role from the whitelist
Ends an active raid lockdown and unlocks all channels
Shows all current automod settings and levels

name: Logging
intro: Send different kinds of events to different channels.

commands.desc: Sets the log channel for a type. Types: messages, users, expressions, channels, voice, moderation, invites, applications, roles
Disables logging for that type
Shows all logging types and their assigned channels
Ignores a user from all logging
Removes a user from the ignore list

name: Stats
intro: Activity from the last 30 days, turned into graphs.

commands.desc: Shows a user's text and voice activity with a graph
Shows a channel's activity with a graph
Shows who made an invite, when, how many people joined through it, and a 30 day graph
Shows server-wide top members and channels
Shows total server messages and voice hours with a graph
Shows how many members joined and left, with a graph

name: Info
intro: Look up details about users, channels, roles, emojis and the server.

commands.desc: Shows info about a user
Shows a user's avatar
Shows a user's banner
Shows info about a channel
Shows info about an emoji
Shows info about the server
Shows the server banner
Shows the server icon
Shows member count breakdown
Shows channel count breakdown
Shows info about a role including permissions
Shows all roles in the server
Shows info about a sticker
Shows all stickers in the server

name: Reminders
intro: Personal reminders. Time formats look like 1h30m or 2d.

commands.desc: Creates a reminder (e.g. 1h30m, 2d)
Shows all your active reminders
Shows a menu to delete a reminder

name: Misc
intro: Everything that does not fit elsewhere: giveaways, notes, translation, starboard and more.

commands.desc: Makes the bot say something in a channel
Shows the bot's latency (works in DMs)
Shows the current server prefix
Changes the server prefix
Adds a note to a user's profile
Removes a note from a user
Shows all notes for a user
Starts a giveaway
Ends a giveaway early
Rerolls a giveaway winner
Looks up a user by their Discord ID
Looks up a user by their username
Shows current starboard config
Sets up the starboard system
Translates text between languages
Shows helpful tips and support options (works in DMs)

name: Games
intro: 17 games, all picked from one menu.

commands.desc: Opens the game menu

note: 8Ball, Coinflip, Dice Roll, Random Joke, Trivia, Rock Paper Scissors, Number Guessing, Tic-Tac-Toe, Would You Rather, Random Quote, Blackjack, Hangman, Connect 4, Slots, Speed Test, Snake and Memory Match.
